newsitem.title: JAPAN: POLL - Japan May c/a surplus seen up over 156 pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Japan May c/a surplus seen up over 156 pct.

text.p: Japan's current account surplus is expected to surge in May from a year earlier due mainly to a jump in its trade surplus in the month, economists said on Tuesday.
The data is to be announced next week. The announcement date has not yet been decided.

A Reuters poll of economists showed forecasts of a surplus ranging from 910 billion yen to 1.26 trillion yen, compared with a surplus of 355.7 billion yen in May 1996. The figures represent an increase ranging from 156 percent to 254 percent.
Economists attributed the sharp increase in the May surplus mainly to a jump in the customs-cleared trade surplus, which grew more than 200 percent in May to 738.27 billion yen.
